programme.title: Angel and the Badman
programme.desc: When a gunslinger with a bad disposition is nursed back to health and desired by a Quaker girl, he finds himself having to choose between his lawless life or the peaceful world of his newfound love.

programme.title: The Cowboy Way
programme.desc: A ranching job in Texas inspires Cody to try and modernize their business with the help of technology, but Booger and Bubba are hesitant that it will be successful. Booger visits Matthew's school during parent's week to teach his classmates about cowboying. Bubba struggles with being away from his family for work and feels the pressure to keep their business close to home. A life-changing opportunity for Booger to compete at a world-renowned colt-starting competition leaves Cody and Bubba excited for their friend, but nervous about what it will mean for their business.

programme.title: The Cowboy Way
programme.desc: With no plans on how to expand their business in sight, the cowboys head to Texas for work. After attending a special cattle sale for Misty's business, Full Moon Cattle, Cody comes up with a possible new business venture. Booger begins training for the Road to the Horse competition, but things don't go smoothly. Feeling like he's in over his head, he receives good advice from an unexpected source. A hand injury affects how much work Bubba can do, but he uses the downtime to build a mock obstacle course for Booger. Kaley tells Bubba about her desire to get into real estate and encourages him to think about a possible career change. Booger challenges Misty to compete against him in the obstacle course, and Jaclyn receives a crash course in barrel racing.

programme.title: The Gun and the Pulpit
programme.desc: The captivating tale of a smooth-talking gunslinger posing as a preacher to hide from his enemies. He ends up bringing hope to his parishioners and law-and-order to a town terrorized by crooks.

programme.title: The Tall Tales of Jim Bridger
programme.desc: Haunted by the memory of leaving a man to die, mountain man Jim Bridger is determined not to repeat the mistake. When his trapping party runs out of water while crossing a barren desert, Bridger struggles desperately to keep his companions alive.

programme.title: Handcrafted America
programme.desc: Host Jill Wagner travels the country on a quest to find talented craftsmen who still make incredible items by hand. First, she travels to a remote area of Alaska to meet husband-and-wife Master Bladesmiths Adam and Haley DesRosiers, who make some of the world's most sought after knives. Then, she heads to Hickory, North Carolina, to meet Master Woodworker Eddie Hamrick, a world-renowned craftsman who can make just about anything out of wood. Finally, Jill is off to Austin, Texas, to meet Cambria Harkey, a leatherworker whose beautiful handbags are appreciated by everyday folks and red-carpet celebrities.

programme.title: State Plate
programme.desc: It's only fitting that Taylor Hicks should travel to Colorado. After all, the largest flat-top mountain is in Grand Mesa. Okay...you're thinking. Well, "mesa" means table in Spanish, and what do we do at the table? Eat! Singer and entertainer Taylor Hicks tastes his way across the Centennial State on a serious quest to discover the state's most emblematic foods. Things heat up in southeastern Colorado, as he roasts Pueblo green chilies then turn cool and sweet when he picks Rocky Ford cantaloupes. In Denver, he scientifically proves just how much sugar is in Olathe sweet corn. And in the heart of the Rockies, Taylor tries his hand at herding world-renowned Colorado lamb, and samples the state's famous Rocky Mountain oysters. It's an overflowing plateful of Colorado cuisine with the stories and legends behind the state's tastiest foods.

programme.title: Legends of the Pony Express
programme.desc: Heroic Pony Express riders and station keepers face deadly terrain, hostile Native Americans, and dangerous outlaws to deliver vital mail across the untamed frontier. Their life-and-death adventures unite the country and become the stuff of legends.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles
programme.desc: Tired of his boring life, attorney Al Jennings dreams of the adventures he reads in dime novels. After a chance encounter with Dick West, Jennings joins the outlaw's gang and learns that a life of crime isn't as glamorous as he thought it would be.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles
programme.desc: Temple Houston, flamboyant son of Sam Houston, works hard to live up to his famous name as a top attorney in the Oklahoma Territory. But his flair for showmanship annoys his courtroom rivals, the Jennings brothers, and the feud erupts into bloodshed.

programme.title: Into The Wild Frontier
programme.desc: Though Andrew Henry has little experience when he partners in a trapping expedition, he pledges his word to complete the risky venture. As Blackfeet warriors close in, he must weigh his personal integrity against the lives of the men he leads.

programme.title: Ultimate Cowboy Showdown
programme.desc: With only eight cowboys left, the competition is neck-and-neck, and everyone has their eyes set on the immunity buckle. The immunity challenge tests their speed and control on horseback in a tournament-style battle, and they go head-to-head until only one remains. Two teammates, who have had it out for each other from the start, decide to set their differences aside for the team's greater good, and to their surprise, they work well together. In the elimination challenge, each team has to sort a herd of cattle by their ear tag colors and drive them into three separate corrals. The blue team comes together to implement a strategy that proves to be effective. The green team makes a risky decision that could cost them the challenge. During elimination, a contestant throws their biggest rival under the bus yet again. Trace sends another cowboy packing.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Joe finds a man burning Ponderosa land and shoots him in self-defense. Joe is left with the responsibility of the man's daughter. He brings her to the Ponderosa, unaware of her outlaw kin searching for her.

programme.title: Into The Wild Frontier
programme.desc: Although from humble beginnings, Tom Fitzpatrick is ambitious and intelligent. When he joins up with William Ashley's trapping expedition, he proves himself to be an invaluable member of the company, both as a hardy frontiersman and a shrewd businessman. Along with legendary mountain man Jedediah Smith, Fitzpatrick rediscovers the South Pass through the Rocky Mountains, opening the pathway that will enable western expansion for decades to come. Fitzpatrick quickly rises to the top of the fur trade and eventually takes over the company he once worked for, but he nearly loses everything when he takes a wrong turn while leading a supply train. Alone in the wilderness, he finds himself in a deadly game of cat-and-mouse with a band of Gros Ventre warriors. Somehow, Fitzpatrick must survive the harrowing trek back to safety without a horse, gun, or supplies.

programme.title: The Warrant
programme.desc: Sheriff John Breaker and his son, Cal, reunite after the Civil War to track down a fellow veteran, now a notorious gang leader. Their mission turns dangerous when they find themselves caught between their former friend's outlaw gang and the vigilantes who are taking the law into their own hands. Starring Neal McDonough (Yellowstone, Captain America), Casper Van Dien (Starship Troopers, Tarzan), Steven R. McQueen (The Vampire Diaries, Chicago Fire), and Annabeth Gish (X-Files, The Haunting of Hill House).

programme.title: Turquoise Fever
programme.desc: While prospecting for a new turquoise mine, the Ottesons discover an abundance of variscite, a gemstone that has recently grown in popularity. The family quickly gets to work to open their first variscite claim. The news of their promising discovery reaches Trenton when he's home with JaKell during the last days of her complicated pregnancy. With Trenton excited and anxious, JaKell assures him she will be fine if he goes out for the day to check out the new claim. For all their help and hard work, Donna and Danny give Tristan and Lane control of their very first mine. Eager to get started, the brothers set up their first dynamite blast, but due to their inexperience, the results are disappointing. Tony and Emily celebrate their tenth wedding anniversary in true Otteson fashion, searching for riches on their new claim.

programme.title: Once Upon a Texas Train
programme.desc: An outlaw and a Texas Ranger have a life-long personal feud, but now, as grumpy older men, they must put their differences aside and face a common problem - a young gang of outlaws ravaging Texas.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Hoss and Joe desperately look for a way to prevent brothers Adam and Ben from being hanged for a crime. A stranger, Lassiter, comes to town in an attempt to find the truth and prove Adam and Ben's innocence.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles
programme.desc: Wild Bill Hickok and his buddy, Davis Tutt, see their friendship fall apart over gambling debts and the affections of a beautiful woman. After Tutt swipes Wild Bill's prized timepiece as payback for a disputed debt, things begin to heat up. Then, when Tutt parades through town with the watch in one hand and Hickok's former girlfriend in the other, Wild Bill's blood begins to boil. Tutt refuses to return the watch, and he continues to flaunt the beautiful woman on his arm. The two men meet in the middle of town to settle their differences once and for all in what will become the very first quick-draw duel of the Old West. Both men reach for their pistols at the same time and fire! In an attempt to separate the truth from the fiction, Bat Masterson, legendary gunfighter-turned-newspaperman, interviews George Ward Nichols, the journalist who immortalized the duel and created the legend of Wild Bill Hickok.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles
programme.desc: Freshly-graduated from medical school, Dr. Susan Anderson sets up a practice in Cripple Creek, Colorado, a rough-and-tumble mining town. At a time when only ten percent of physicians are female, Dr. Anderson faces her share of doubters and has a difficult time attracting patients in the frontier town. When miners suddenly rush into her office with an injured boy, she defies prevailing wisdom and decides to save his mangled arm instead of amputating the limb. The risks are enormous. If the boy's arm becomes infected, and he dies, she will lose everything. Years later, Dr. Anderson relives the story while treating Bat Masterson, legendary gunfighter-turned-newspaperman, who comes down with fever while passing through Cripple Creek.

programme.title: State Plate
programme.desc: Eureka! Yes, it is exciting that singer and entertainer Taylor Hicks is heading to California in this episode of State Plate! But "Eureka" is also California's state motto translated from Greek, meaning "I found it!" The motto was adopted in 1849 and is associated with the discovery of gold. Will Taylor strike "gold" in his search for California's most iconic foods? As he tastes his way across the Golden State, Taylor tries his hand at harvesting artichokes and grafting avocado trees. On the coast, he learns how to make the famed San Francisco fish stew, cioppino, and tastes sourdough bread made with a special yeast that thrives in this area of the country. For dessert, Taylor shakes things up with a mechanical tree shaker in order to harvest almonds. It's a plateful of California cuisine filled with the stories and legends behind the state's tastiest foods.

programme.desc: Jo is a single mum with two little girls, she’d like a dog as part of their family. Jo loves running and would love a dog that can join her, but having two small girls a smaller dog might be better. Can Dr. Lisa find the right dog?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Dr Chris Brown and Dr Lisa Chimes head out to the burnt regions of the Blue Mountains on the Sydney outskirts the day after some of the most intense bushfires on record. The mass evacuations of farms and properties have left animals injured, stranded or in distress. The Bondi Vet team take to the road to help where they can. The last thing Chris expected was to be treating a baby alpaca named Jersey. Jersey’s mother went into premature labour, brought on by the stressful evacuation of the herd from their fire threatened property. Now the new-born Cria (baby alpaca) is listless and deteriorating alarming.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: In this episode of Bondi Vet, Georgie, a small rescue dog, is brought in to see Dr Chris Brown. programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Dr Chris is heading to the Halls Gap Zoo in Western Victoria where Stephanie the Lemur awaits. programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Dr Chris has received a call from Tim Faulkner at the Australian Reptile Park. programme.title: Bondi Vet

For safety reasons Zambi has had to be removed from her mother by carers Donna and Mandy from the animal welfare organization LOTL (Life On The Line) Rescue. Not only does the young lion require a medical checkup but she also needs a surrogate mother and Dr Chris has the perfect – while very strange solution. No one is sure if it will work.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris is in Cairns, a place he loves because no case is ever straightforward in the tropics and he is not disappointed. programme.title: Wild Life of Tim Faulkner
programme.desc: Tim provides a countdown of the most dangerous jobs at the Australian Reptile Park before introducing us to Reggie and Russell, two orphaned kangaroo joeys he’s helping to raise.

programme.title: Wild Life of Tim Faulkner
programme.desc: Tim travels to one of the last remnants of original vegetation in Western Australia in search of the numbat - one of the world’s rarest animals.

programme.title: Wild Life of Tim Faulkner
programme.desc: Tim delves into a particular Aussie specialty – venom. Discussing why Australia has the most potent animals on the planet before a visit to Fraser Island in search of its most famous resident – the dingo.

programme.title: Wild Life of Tim Faulkner
programme.desc: Tiger snakes are different on Kangaroo Island and Tim just has to pop over to see just how different they are. Later he visits a friend who has been camping out for months researching the love life of the red backed toadlet.

programme.title: Wild Life of Tim Faulkner
programme.desc: Tim visits Kangaroo Island to check out what’s being done to halt the destruction of the island’s manna gum trees by local koalas. At the Australian Reptile Park it’s time to find out who the trouble maker is down at the gator lagoon.

programme.title: Wild Life of Tim Faulkner
programme.desc: There is a surprise in store at reception for Tim and a call out to a python that needs rescuing from up a drainpipe. Tim then puts to bed a number of myths surrounding Aussie wildlife.

programme.title: Wild Life of Tim Faulkner

programme.title: Wild Life of Tim Faulkner
programme.desc: It’s back to the Australian Reptile Park for Tim’s eldest son Bill. There’s a tiger snake to milk, kangaroo yards to clean and parrots to feed. A call from a friend then sees Tim head north to help an African exotic have its hooves trimmed.

programme.title: Wild Life of Tim Faulkner

programme.title: Wild Life of Tim Faulkner
programme.desc: Tim is taken on a journey round Kooljaman, the ancestral home of his old mate Brian Lee. On the way they discover how life was once lived amongst the traditional owners of the land.

programme.title: Wild Life of Tim Faulkner

programme.desc: Milton has put a bounty on the biggest barramundi someone can catch at Coolibah. It’s an annual fishing competition.

programme.title: Keeping up with the Joneses
programme.desc: Bushfires break out at Coolibah. It’s Milton’s worst fear. With the fire burning up paddocks of cattle feed, he’ll have to fight through the night to contain it.

programme.title: Keeping up with the Joneses

programme.title: Keeping up with the Joneses
programme.desc: Milton faces his worst nightmare. News is radioed through that a chopper has crashed 50km from Coolibah. He heads up a search party to find the wreckage and, hopefully, survivors.

programme.title: Keeping up with the Joneses

programme.desc: After the parents of Ruby (Leelee Sobieski) and her younger brother, Rhett (Trevor Morgan), are killed in a car crash, their parents' best friends, Erin and Terry Glass (Diane Lane, Stellan Skarsgard), become their guardians. Before very long, though, Ruby suspects that Erin and Terry may not be the ideal guardians they seemed to be.

programme.desc: When a Texas oil tycoon’s body is found in his beauty queen girlfriend’s mansion, police fear the worst and issue a nationwide alert to find her. As evidence comes to light, no one is sure whether they’re hunting for a victim…or a killer.

programme.title: Cruise Ship Killers
programme.desc: Deanna, a youth ministry attendee, mysteriously disappears aboard a cruise ship while out at sea. Who could have done this, and why? Could someone in the ministry have any information of what happened? Is anyone hiding any important details that may lead to her whereabouts?

programme.title: Beyond Reasonable Doubt
programme.desc: Examining real cases and critical events where truth, consequence, and human decisions collide.

programme.title: InJustice
programme.desc: A child serial killer terrorizes the city of Saskatoon; a high school student is tortured to death over the course of a weekend by a gang. The killer, a man who was pronounced clinically dead in an ambulance and later revived, embarked on a string of serial murders six months later.

programme.title: Happily Never After
programme.desc: Godly Llius finds her eternal forever when she pledges her love to music promoter Tony. But their holy union is disrupted in the most gruesome of ways. As detectives look closer, sinister truths emerge from the darkness to reveal a devilish devotion.

programme.title: Kids In Prison Then & Now
programme.desc: Juveniles under the age of 18 who are sentenced to adult prison must be sound and sight separated from their adult counterparts. But once a youth turns 18, he is immediately transferred from a small Youth cell block into the full adult prison population. In this exclusive video, 18-year olds Alexander and Michael learn exactly how scary this process can be, when they get the news that today is their transfer day. Cameras follow the boys as they pack their things, say goodbye to their cellmates and make the harrowing walk across the prison yard. As they get closer to the adult cell block that will be their "home" for the next few years, Alexander is filled with questions as he asks prison guards how things will be. Once inside their new adult cell block, prisoners peer out of their cell doors to see the new arrivals. As the youngest kids on the block, Alexander and Michael are unsure of what lies ahead. A 2023 update is included at the end of this video.

programme.title: Kids In Prison Then & Now
programme.desc: We look back at the cases of teenagers Damone and Robert as they were spending their first years inside a maximum-security adult prison. Both Damone and Robert were in the prison's Segregation unit, where they were locked down 23 hours a day, 7 days a week. As prison guards leashed the boys with a leather strap and walked them to a holding cell, we interviewed the boys through the cell cuffport and asked how they were surviving isolation, what landed them in prison in the first place, their family history, and ultimately, what they hoped for their futures. We then see updates on the boys 13 years later, and find out if the hopes and dreams they told us about as teenagers turned into reality once they were adults.

programme.title: Life with Murder
programme.desc: When their son is accused of murdering his sister, a mother and father face perhaps the most awful decision any parent could have to make: whether to break with their son or accept him back into the family. With astonishing footage shot over a ten-year period, from minutes after the crime was committed to the present, the film follows the family's evolving relationships.

programme.title: Murder Remembered - Norfolk County 1950
programme.desc: This feature-length docu-drama brings us back to 1950 in a smalltown Ontario bank, the scene of an armed hold-up by Herbert McAuliffe. By nightfall, two men are dead. The robber flees, and for three days the community of Norfolk County lives in fear. Gritty re-enactments and first-hand accounts show the manhunt and eventual trial, shedding new light on McAuliffe's personality--his tragic childhood and respected WWII record. The result is a thought-provoking contribution to the debate on capital punishment.

programme.title: Crime Stories
programme.desc: Firsthand accounts, dramatic re-enactments and archival news footage are used to paint comprehensive pictures of the high-profile cases and the law enforcement agents who investigated them.

programme.title: Dark Waters of Crime
programme.desc: Water is at the centre of the human experience. The source of life on earth, it is also a place of mystery and danger. For criminals, water is the perfect accomplice for the perfect crime: it erases, absorbs, and carries the bodies, conceals weapons and washes away evidence. For detectives, water is a crafty adversary. It never confesses, forcing the investigators to employ extraordinary measures to discover the truth. Dark Waters of Crime does not simply oppose the criminals and the investigators. It brings into play a third party, powerful, mysterious, and tenacious.

programme.title: American Justice on Trial: People v. Newton
programme.desc: In ’67, Huey Newton, Black Panthers co-founder, was accused of killing a white cop in Oakland. The landmark trial exposes judicial racism, leading to a shocking, impactful verdict.

programme.title: Criminally Insane
programme.desc: Criminally Insane takes viewers on an unprecedented journey through the Clifton T. Perkins hospital in Jessup, Maryland, a maximum-security institution for the criminally insane. All the patients at Perkins have been found not guilty by reason of insanity, and virtually all have committed extremely violent crimes. Elsoudani El-Wahhabi stabbed a woman to death, then cut out his own tongue. Brian Bechtold murdered both his parents with a shotgun when he was just 17 years old. Todd E. beat his mother with a baseball bat, then finished her off with a kitchen knife. In one hour, CRIMINALLY INSANE portrays the most intimate details of life among the dangerously mentally ill. We learn what’s being done for them and, more importantly, who decides whether these terrifying individuals are ready to be released.

programme.title: Waco Siege: How David Koresh Purged His Followers With Fire
programme.desc: Dive headfirst into the heart of darkness with the bone-chilling tale of the Waco Siege. Prepare to be consumed by the sinister saga as the Branch Davidians, under the charismatic sway of David Koresh, engage in a harrowing battle against the relentless forces of authority. Witness the explosive showdown that erupts into a cataclysmic inferno, leaving behind a haunting legacy of violence and uncertainty. Brace yourself for a descent into the abyss, where bullets rain down and flames engulf, and the horrifying truth lies buried amidst the ashes.

programme.title: Dark Waters of Crime
programme.desc: Water is at the centre of the human experience. The source of life on earth, it is also a place of mystery and danger. For criminals, water is the perfect accomplice for the perfect crime: it erases, absorbs, and carries the bodies, conceals weapons and washes away evidence. For detectives, water is a crafty adversary. It never confesses, forcing the investigators to employ extraordinary measures to discover the truth. Dark Waters of Crime does not simply oppose the criminals and the investigators. It brings into play a third party, powerful, mysterious, and tenacious.

programme.title: Ruby Ridge: How Randy Weaver Got His Family Massacred By Fbi
programme.desc: We dive into the controversial events surrounding Ruby Ridge. Join us as we uncover the intense standoff that unfolded between federal agents and the Weaver family in 1992. Witness the heartbreaking bloodshed that ensued, igniting a nationwide debate on government overreach and the right to bear arms. Explore the lasting impact of this tragic incident, which continues to resonate in the realms of protest, gun control, and civil liberties. Don't miss this gripping exploration of Ruby Ridge and its far-reaching implications.

programme.title: British Gangsters: Faces Of The Underworld
programme.desc: Everyone has the right to tell their story… The powerful and thought-provoking documentary series returns with eight more fascinating episodes. Bernard O’Mahoney takes the helm once again as he interviews some of the most notorious ‘faces’ in recent history, taking the viewer on a brand new journey that brings the story of crime up-to-date. The best-selling true-crime author and former Essex Boys gang member travels to Liverpool, Birmingham, Belfast, Dublin and Essex and guides us through tales of drugs, gangs, political terrorism and ultimately, consequences.

programme.title: Fatal Crimes
programme.desc: When a Texas oil tycoon’s body is found in his beauty queen girlfriend’s mansion, police fear the worst and issue a nationwide alert to find her. As evidence comes to light, no one is sure whether they’re hunting for a victim…or a killer.

programme.desc: Deanna, a youth ministry attendee, mysteriously disappears aboard a cruise ship while out at sea. Who could have done this, and why? Could someone in the ministry have any information of what happened? Is anyone hiding any important details that may lead to her whereabouts?

programme.title: Kids In Prison Then & Now
programme.desc: We look back at the cases of teenagers Damone and Robert as they were spending their first years inside a maximum-security adult prison. Both Damone and Robert were in the prison's Segregation unit, where they were locked down 23 hours a day, 7 days a week. As prison guards leashed the boys with a leather strap and walked them to a holding cell, we interviewed the boys through the cell cuffport and asked how they were surviving isolation, what landed them in prison in the first place, their family history, and ultimately, what they hoped for their futures. We then see updates on the boys 13 years later, and find out if the hopes and dreams they told us about as teenagers turned into reality once they were adults.

programme.title: Kids In Prison Then & Now
programme.desc: Juveniles under the age of 18 who are sentenced to adult prison must be sound and sight separated from their adult counterparts. But once a youth turns 18, he is immediately transferred from a small Youth cell block into the full adult prison population. In this exclusive video, 18-year olds Alexander and Michael learn exactly how scary this process can be, when they get the news that today is their transfer day. Cameras follow the boys as they pack their things, say goodbye to their cellmates and make the harrowing walk across the prison yard. As they get closer to the adult cell block that will be their "home" for the next few years, Alexander is filled with questions as he asks prison guards how things will be. Once inside their new adult cell block, prisoners peer out of their cell doors to see the new arrivals. As the youngest kids on the block, Alexander and Michael are unsure of what lies ahead. A 2023 update is included at the end of this video.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: What creates a monster? As the popular new Netflix series Dahmer - Monster: The Jeffrey Dahmer Story pushes the heinous crimes of the notorious serial killer back into the spotlight, what can we learn about what may have made him the evil he was? Do chilling home videos of Jeffrey Dahmer as a little boy show an innocent child before he became evil? Or, were the signs already there? His parents reveal the red flags they say they missed.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Contemporary weddings have turned into five-star productions, with couples pulling out all the stops to shine on their special day. But what happens when the bride or groom-to-be starts making diva-like demands? Mike and Jamie agreed to a small Vegas wedding, but that went out the window when Jamie switched her gown three times, rented a limo to drive her one block and upgraded her engagement ring. Mike says that Jamie also made him uninvite all of his friends and cancelled his bachelor party! Are Jamie’s antics a hint of what’s to come in their marriage? Then, Nastassia complains that her husband-to-be, Richard, is cheap. She says he wants her to buy bridal flowers from the grocery store, have her mom sew her gown and even schedule the wedding before year's end so he can get a tax write-off! Will Richard’s tightwad ways force Nastassia to call off the wedding?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tracy is a successful, working actress who has appeared on many daytime soap operas including The Bold and The Beautiful and The Young and The Restless. She wrote into the show urgently seeking Dr. Phil’s help for her real-life drama of her hoarding 71-year-old-mother, Robin, who could be evicted from her home at any minute. Tracy claims her mother’s homes have always been filled with filth, chaos, and animals, and she’s never taken responsibility for the conditions Tracy lived in growing up. Tracy says she feels like the child of a drug addict, except the drug is hoarding, and she’s looking for Dr. Phil’s help to truly change her mom’s behavior before she’s back in another house of filth again. Robin says she knows she needs help with her hoarding, but the idea of getting rid of her possessions gives her anxiety. She says she’s ready to fix herself with the help of Dr. Phil, and this show is an answer to her prayers.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: With the economy in trouble, a lot of people are under pressure and getting desperate. Learn the tools to protect yourself from liars, cheats and scammers who are trying to take advantage.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil shares advice for dealing with rude, crude and obnoxious behavior from your family members.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Sara says her ex-husband, Mark, has brainwashed their three grown children against her, and she just wants to reclaim a place in their lives. Mark and his new wife, Mikel, say they’re afraid of Sara but are willing to face her onstage with Dr. Phil. Can these exes put the past behind them and make peace? And, is Sara’s 22-year-old daughter willing to fix their broken relationship?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: You've heard people complain, "If I only knew then what I know now, I wouldn't be in this mess," but what about those times when you choose not to see the writing on the wall? Dr. Phil meets couples who say their relationships went from bad to worse after they said, "I do," and now their families are broken.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A man accuses his ex-wife and her new husband of killing his children.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his interview with Tommy, who accuses his ex-wife, Julia, and her new husband, Codey, of killing his 19-month-old son, Darby, and 4-year-old stepdaughter, Kiera -- an allegation the couple vehemently deny. Dr. Phil enlists the help of forensic pathologist Dr. Cyril Wecht to examine the children’s autopsy reports -- what are his findings? And, will Julia and Codey agree to take polygraph tests?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: What happens when an unhealthy teen relationship threatens to tear a mother and daughter apart? Giesel says her 18-year-old daughter, Devynn, is obsessed with her boyfriend and is damaging a once promising future. Watch the drama unfold as a pregnancy scare rocks this teen's life.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Couples who say their marriage is on the rocks due to debt.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Christina and Jim are divorced, and their 21-year-old daughter, Tara, is living with her dad and his new wife who just happens to be the same age as Tara. Christina claims Jim was a horrible husband and a narcissist and she was forced to walk away from the family when Tara was just 13. Since then, she says Jim has let Tara get away with anything and now even allows her to work as a webcam model in order to help pay the bills! She says he is turning their daughter into a raging, angry monster with low self-esteem.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his conversation with Christina, who emailed him desperate for help for her daughter, Tara, who she says can be an angry monster. Christina left the home when Tara was 13 years old, but now, she says she's worried that her daughter is in a toxic situation with the ex-husband she calls narcissistic and his 22-year-old new wife who is 20 weeks pregnant. Today, meet the new wife and find out if Dr. Phil can help this chaotic triangle.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Everyone knows people that love to bicker. But what happens when the bickering escalates into verbal abuse and violence? Dr. Phil checks in with past guests Troy and Tammy whose explosive arguing is the primary dynamic in their marriage. Have they been able to break the cycle of drama or are they one step closer to divorce? Then—meet a single mother of five who worries that her children’s bickering may lead to fatal consequences! She thinks they’re out of control. So why is her daughter pointing the finger at her? Dr. Phil helps her end the fighting once and for all.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Bloody attacks, arrests, mug shots and undercover stings - Dr. Phil explores these extreme outcomes of in-law conflicts. Meet two wives whose rocky relationships with their in-laws led to criminal consequences.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A mom is supposed to love and nurture her children, but what if she's too involved? Reed, 33, says his mother, Margaret, is so meddling, manipulative and controlling that the day she dies will be a cause for celebration, not mourning. He claims she uses bribes to control his every move, including offering him $20,000 to divorce his first wife. Margaret admits that she can be pushy and difficult but says she just wants to see her son succeed in life. Is she really setting him up for failure? Does Reed really want to man-up and break free from his mother's grasp? And, is Margaret willing to let him go? Then, 35-year-old Anthony, star of the new TLC reality show Mama's Boys of the Bronx, says he sees nothing wrong with living at home and letting his mom, Patti, wait on him hand and foot. How does Patti feel about their living arrangement? Will she ever kick Anthony out? Plus, hear how Anthony's lifestyle affects his dating life. If you know of a mother-son bond that's a little too close for comfort, don't miss this Dr. Phil. Reed, 33, says his mother, Margaret, is so meddling and controlling that the day she dies will be a cause for celebration. Margaret says she wants to see her son succeed - but is she setting him up for failure? Plus, 35-year-old Anthony, star of TLC's Mama's Boys of the Bronx, says he sees nothing wrong with living at home.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Melinda and Amy claim their lives have been turned upside down by a social media influencer and political activist named Paloma, who they say has subjected them to nine months of cyberbullying and harassment. Paloma says they’ve got it all wrong and that she is the victim of their cyberbullying. Who is the real victim? Will Dr. Phil convince these three women to “log off” from each other? Find out in this explosive episode!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: One-time high school sweethearts Tracey and Doug started having marriage problems when Doug admitted to having an affair with a transgender female, Essence.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When you get married, you look forward to a life filled with love, happiness and security. But what if you find out your spouse has been telling you lies and is someone completely different than the person you thought you knew?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In the last 10 years, the number of women arrested for driving drunk has risen by 30 percent, and police report that more and more young children are sitting in the back seat when these moms are pulled over.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: April says another woman is electronically stealing photos of her children and posing as their mother online.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his conversation with husband and wife, Nathan and April, who claim a woman named Ashley is fixated on their beautiful twin daughters.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Christina, 21, and her younger sister, Carlie, 13, say they had a close relationship with their father, Michael, until two years ago when he decided to transition to a female. Michael was a police officer, soldier and loving parent who lived his life as a male for 40 years. Now, he wants his daughters to call him Mom, because he says Dad is gone, but they refuse. Michael, who prefers to be called Kayla, says she wants to explain to her daughters why she's living as a woman, but they've never given her the chance. The last time Christina saw her father was two years ago when he showed up at her work in lace and blue jeans to break the news that he's transgendered. When she sees Kayla onstage, does she greet her with open arms? Next, Carlie joins her sister and father. She says she wants her old dad back, but will she feel the same after seeing Kayla? Can the father-daughter bond be turned into a mother-daughter one? Be prepared for an emotional journey as two daughters struggle to understand how someone they loved so much could hurt them so badly.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A father is fighting for custody of his 4 children because his ex-wife is allegedly in a cult.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Phyllis and Barry say they're desperate to calm their violent 15-year-old son, Brandon, and turn to Dr. Phil for help. Their requests for Brandon to perform simple tasks such as brushing his teeth or bathing cause him to go into a rage, breaking things and punching holes in walls, and even chasing Phyllis with scissors. Barry says they walk on eggshells, waiting for Brandon’s next violent outburst and that every day he leaves the house worried that his wife may not be alive when he returns. What is at the root of Brandon's anger? Dr. Phil spends some one-on-one time with the young man to determine what’s driving his behavior. And, find out what Phyllis recently found in Brandon’s room that shocked her to her core.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In the summer of 2014, a former middle school English teacher was arrested on suspicion of statutory rape and contributing to the delinquency of a minor after police found her in a motel room with a 15-year-old former student. In a Dr. Phil exclusive, Jennifer Caswell speaks out for the first time. How does she explain her relationship with her former student?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Brenda says she fell in love with and married her husband, Don – despite their 26-year age gap. programme.desc: t’s been almost four months since 5-year-old Summer Wells vanished from her home in rural Tennessee on June 15, 2021. Don and Candus agreed to sit down with body language experts Scott Rouse and Greg Hartley, interrogators who have worked with the FBI, law enforcement and the military and have been referred to as a human lie detector, in hopes of clearing their name. Find out what the men think and if Dr. Phil agrees with their findings.

programme.title: Dr. Phil

Instead, the couple say they became targets of online bullies who accused them of involvement in the disappearance of their missing child. programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: You hear about scams all the time - e-mails and voicemails claiming you have won valuable prizes. Dr. Phil is outraged by what some scammers are doing to him, his family and his viewers. One website offers a Dr. Phil quiz to win $5,000 every hour, another says it has the official Dr. Phil personality test, but even more shocking are 800 numbers that take callers' money for the promise of over the phone therapy with Dr. Phil and Robin. But these 800 numbers connect innocent victims with con artists posing as Dr. Phil staff members. The fake staffers ask anywhere from $375 to $1,000 for consultation time that obviously never takes place.

programme.desc: A woman who was nabbed for jaywalking claims the police were out of line for arresting her. A woman is brought in on domestic-violence charges, and a drug peddler claims he's selling to support his addiction to poker.

programme.desc: Officers fear a man may attempt to hang himself and decide to intervene. A heavily injured man ends up in jail after taking cocaine and acid. Irascibility shadows a man with low blood sugar.

programme.desc: A hysterical woman is transferred to an isolation cell. A woman shows her undying LA pride to the arresting officers. A young woman is put under observation for threatening harm to herself.

programme.desc: An uncooperative woman fights arrest resulting in a trip to the isolation chamber. One inmate calls 911 within jail walls causing confusion. Later, officers run to the rescue when a man passes out.

programme.desc: Officers find hidden drugs on a burglary suspect during a pat down that leads to a tense confrontation. programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: In Salt Lake City, UT a belligerent woman is restrained. In Portland, OR a repeat offender is placed in isolation for unruly behavior. programme.desc: A jail chaplain counsels a sad inmate. An intoxicated woman demands to talk to the Canadian Embassy.

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: After refusing a breathalyzer test, an irate man bangs his head against plexiglass. A man transforms into a “cell warrior” within his holding pen. Soon to be released, an inmate considers the future.

programme.desc: Two sisters go on a mini-crime spree, get caught and find no one will bail them out. A domestic argument about night fishing lands a husband in jail for breaking into his own car. programme.desc: A woman booked for domestic violence begins screaming and can’t calm down. Two friends arrested for public intoxication embrace in a tearful reunion. Later, a woman is brought in with a stolen car.

programme.desc: In Las Vegas, NV an intoxicated man is strapped to a restraining chair. In Portland, OR a seemingly gracious man is arrested for assault. programme.desc: A man tries to swallow his ring. A heroin addict wants help when he realizes his habit has cost him everything he loves. programme.desc: A strip search reveals a male inmate in women's lingerie. A couple of puppy thieves get amorous in the bathroom, and a pregnant woman is arrested for solicitation.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: GLORY featherweight world champion Petch (175-40-3, 27 KO) will rematch KO artist Abraham Vidales (18-4, 14 KO) and Portuguese sensation Miguel Trindade (64-8, 26 KO) will look to avenge his 2023 loss to the always entertaining Berjan Peposhi (32-6, 16 KO). Former GLORY title contender & leading Japanese fighter Kento Haraguchi (28-6-1, 18 KO) will go up against talented newcomer Hiroki Kasahara (39-8, 17 KO) while popular South Korean veteran Sung-hyun Lee (71-13-2, 17 KO) takes on top young prospect Yura Kono (17-1, 9 KO). In addition, the seven-fight card will be headlined by Shiro Matsumoto (55-17-4, 19 KO) defending his RISE bantamweight title against Koki Osaki (38-6-1, 21 KO). In the co-main event, budding superstar Ryujin Nasukawa (17-2, 8 KO) and heavy-hitter Kaito Hasegawa (17-2, 13 KO) battle for the vacant RISE super flyweight championship.
